title: Electrical Power-Line Installers and Repairers
description: Install or repair cables or wires used in electrical power or distribution systems. May erect poles and light or heavy duty transmission towers.

tasks.text: Adhere to safety practices and procedures, such as checking equipment regularly and erecting barriers around work areas.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — AI reviews records; human observes physical procedures

dwas.name: Monitor work areas or procedures to ensure compliance with safety procedures.

tasks.text: Drive vehicles equipped with tools and materials to job sites.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Driving vehicles at work sites is situated mobility

dwas.name: Drive trucks or other vehicles to or at work sites.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Open switches or attach grounding devices to remove electrical hazards from disturbed or fallen lines or to facilitate repairs.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical power supply connection work

dwas.name: Control power supply connections.

tasks.text: Climb poles or use truck-mounted buckets to access equipment.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Climbing structures requires physical mobility

dwas.name: Climb equipment or structures to access work areas.

tasks.text: Install, maintain, and repair electrical distribution and transmission systems, including conduits, cables, wires, and related equipment, such as transformers, circuit breakers, and switches.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on wiring repair in physical environment

dwas.name: Assemble electrical components, subsystems, or systems.
Repair electrical circuits or wiring.

tasks.text: Inspect and test power lines and auxiliary equipment to locate and identify problems, using reading and testing instruments.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Electrical testing requires hands-on instrument use

dwas.name: Inspect electrical or electronic systems for defects.
Test electrical equipment or systems to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Coordinate work assignment preparation and completion with other workers.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Real-time coworker coordination is relational work

dwas.name: Confer with coworkers to coordinate work activities.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Replace or straighten damaged poles.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical alignment of machinery requires hands

dwas.name: Align equipment or machinery.

tasks.text: String wire conductors and cables between poles, towers, trenches, pylons, and buildings, setting lines in place and using winches to adjust tension.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Running wiring is hands-on installation

dwas.name: Run wiring to connect equipment.

tasks.text: Attach cross-arms, insulators, and auxiliary equipment to poles prior to installing them.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mechanical assembly needs hands and tools

dwas.name: Assemble mechanical components or machine parts.

tasks.text: Dig holes, using augers, and set poles, using cranes and power equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Crane/hoist operation demands real-time physical control

dwas.name: Dig holes or trenches.
Operate cranes, hoists, or other moving or lifting equipment.

tasks.text: Travel in trucks, helicopters, and airplanes to inspect lines for freedom from obstruction and adequacy of insulation.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Physical travel to sites requires human mobility

dwas.name: Travel to work sites to perform installation, repair or maintenance work.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Identify defective sectionalizing devices, circuit breakers, fuses, voltage regulators, transformers, switches, relays, or wiring, using wiring diagrams and electrical-testing instruments.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Defect detection in electrical systems needs presence

dwas.name: Inspect electrical or electronic systems for defects.

tasks.text: Install watt-hour meters and connect service drops between power lines and consumers' facilities.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Connecting electrical components is manual work

dwas.name: Install metering equipment.
Connect electrical components or equipment.

tasks.text: Test conductors, according to electrical diagrams and specifications, to identify corresponding conductors and to prevent incorrect connections.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electrical probing and meter work by hand

dwas.name: Test electrical circuits or components for proper functioning.

tasks.text: Place insulating or fireproofing materials over conductors and joints.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Insulation installation requires manual fitting

dwas.name: Install insulation in equipment or structures.

tasks.text: Splice or solder cables together or to overhead transmission lines, customer service lines, or street light lines, using hand tools, epoxies, or specialized equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Connecting electrical components is manual work

dwas.name: Connect electrical components or equipment.
Solder parts or connections between parts.

tasks.text: Trim trees that could be hazardous to the functioning of cables or wires.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical cutting to specifications

dwas.name: Cut materials according to specifications or needs.

tasks.text: Pull up cable by hand from large reels mounted on trucks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Laying cables requires physical routing work

dwas.name: Lay cables to connect equipment.

tasks.text: Lay underground cable directly in trenches, or string it through conduit running through the trenches.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Laying cables requires physical routing work

dwas.name: Lay cables to connect equipment.

tasks.text: Cut trenches for laying underground cables, using trenchers and cable plows.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual digging with tools in ground

dwas.name: Dig holes or trenches.

tasks.text: Cut and peel lead sheathing and insulation from defective or newly installed cables and conduits prior to splicing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical cutting to specifications

dwas.name: Cut materials according to specifications or needs.

tasks.text: Clean, tin, and splice corresponding conductors by twisting ends together or by joining ends with metal clamps and soldering connections.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Connecting electrical components is manual work

dwas.name: Connect electrical components or equipment.
Solder parts or connections between parts.
